readOnlyInvestigationDesign.meaning: The hypotheses below can be reviewed statically; no implementation, probe or CI execution was performed.

freshHostTranslationUnit.staticBasis: pipeline.main rejects a pre-existing objdir, performs full mach build, validates MacWebAppService.o as an x86_64 object and requires its mtime >= this task start.

primaryFailure.whyNoBSDQuery: DarwinActivity.read immediately returns unavailable/permission on EPERM/EACCES before calling bsd(). This is an existing explicit branch, not evidence of a failed zombie-enabled BSD query.
primaryFailure.interpretation: Task measurement was denied. The evidence does not identify a browser, Shim, helper or system process as the denied member, and does not prove natural browser exit or a stable denied generation.

interruptionAndNativeEvidence.keyboardInterruptInterpretation: Compatible with the monitor-triggered stop path, which starts with SIGINT to the suite group. This is an inference from ordering and code; no syscall trace proves the signal delivery sequence.
notEstablished: A spontaneous native browser exit in this run
Recurrence of the historical cause-host-exited failure
interruptionAndNativeEvidence.firstCauseNullMeaning: No completed controlled authenticated-cancellation proof was copied into native.firstCause. Null does not identify a root cause.
interruptionAndNativeEvidence.historicalOriginalNativeCause: UNKNOWN; historical labels in summary.priorExecution are not new observations.

remainingLimits: Permission return contains no UID, birth or role because the early branch precedes BSD identity retrieval.
A stable pidTag identifies the same PID value under the probe key; it is not a process-generation identifier.
The stage records only the cleanup exception type. It does not identify whether PermissionError came from killpg with signal zero or a nonzero cleanup signal.
No raw native stdout/stderr was published. Existing per-phase projection limits remain as documented in the separate native evidence coverage review.

cleanupAssessment.registryGuarantee: No registered, recognized owned host/Shim/helper remained and registry census raised no recorded errors. All three observed category counts were zero.
doesNotGuarantee: Successful cleanup of the denied process
Absence of unregistered or different-UID group members
Absence of zombies or system-marked group members
staticBasis: Runner.group_alive catches only ProcessLookupError from killpg(pgid,0); PermissionError propagates.
Runner.stop invokes group_alive before signalling and during each grace loop. A permission failure interrupts this sequence.
Runner.run discards its local group-set entry in finally even on cleanup exceptions; an empty tracking set is not proof of OS process termination.
The stage exitCode reads process.returncode; it does not perform an unconditional wait/reap after cleanup errors.
MacProcesses.pids limits registry candidates to the current effective UID; OwnedNative.census then restricts recognized executable/profile/generation identities.
OwnedNative.finish computes allOwnedGone from an empty remaining registered set plus no census errors. Zero observed instances makes this a limited registry result.
cleanupAssessment.xnuNuance: The reference XNU process-group signal path excludes SZOMB/system processes and can return EPERM when no eligible member is found. PermissionError alone therefore proves neither a live privileged survivor nor successful cleanup.
cleanupAssessment.observedClaim: Whole group cleanup remains unverified; no stronger completion claim is supported.

timeAndScope.interpretation: Failure occurred before the unchanged six-hour platform budget; there is no time-only manual cancellation in the receipt.

sdkAssessment.localUseAfterServiceExpiry: Allowed by the existing fixed TAR/tree/version validation; the later listing does not invalidate already acquired bytes.
sdkAssessment.anotherAcquisition: NOT_PERFORMED; do not try to retrieve or bypass the expired fixed artifact.

nextNoninvasiveHypotheses.hypothesis: A group member had different credentials, potentially after an exec transition.
nextNoninvasiveHypotheses.staticBasis: The reference XNU task-info path requires same-user authorization; proc_security_policy can return EPERM for a UID mismatch. Group inventory records PGID/PID only.
nextNoninvasiveHypotheses.discriminatingReadOnlyEvidence: In a separately reviewed future diagnostic path, retain only same/different/unknown UID relation, PPID/PGID membership, bounded allowed executable-role classification, numeric per-flavor return/errno and identity availability. Keep raw argv/tokens private and all unknown measurements unavailable.
nextNoninvasiveHypotheses.currentLimit: The denied UID, birth and role were not recorded; neither browser nor privileged-helper attribution is justified.

nextNoninvasiveHypotheses.hypothesis: A platform/MAC policy denied task information even if UID matched.
nextNoninvasiveHypotheses.staticBasis: The reference XNU proc_security_policy calls mac_proc_check_proc_info before its same-user check, so EPERM alone cannot distinguish policy from ownership.
nextNoninvasiveHypotheses.discriminatingReadOnlyEvidence: Compare permitted identity-only metadata calls and their per-flavor byte/errno results under unchanged credentials. A short BSD-info read may expose diagnostic metadata where allowed, but must not authorize resource counters or replace ownership/birth checks. Do not change entitlements, signing or permissions.
nextNoninvasiveHypotheses.currentLimit: No supplementary BSD query was attempted on the EPERM branch; the actual runner kernel/policy was not pinned by this source comparison.

nextNoninvasiveHypotheses.hypothesis: After interrupting eligible children, the remaining group state became non-signalable, zombie-only or otherwise had no eligible member for killpg(0).
nextNoninvasiveHypotheses.staticBasis: Runner.stop starts with SIGINT and later probes the group. Reference XNU killpg1 filters zombies/system members and may return EPERM when none are eligible.
nextNoninvasiveHypotheses.discriminatingReadOnlyEvidence: Record allowlisted cleanup operation name, signal number, errno, fresh membership/status availability, and the verified Popen child poll/wait result separately. Preserve unavailable group state instead of calling it gone.
nextNoninvasiveHypotheses.currentLimit: KeyboardInterrupt plus PermissionError is compatible with this sequence but does not prove it; no per-operation cleanup journal or reap result exists.

nextNoninvasiveHypotheses.hypothesis: Nested harness or launcher activity introduced the first denied group member before a matching native instance was registered.
nextNoninvasiveHypotheses.staticBasis: native_suite spawns each harness without a new session, and HostProcess similarly spawns open without a new session. The group monitor and recognized-native registry therefore cover different sets and times.
nextNoninvasiveHypotheses.discriminatingReadOnlyEvidence: Review the fixed subprocess graph offline; design opaque role/phase and parent-generation correlation for existing permitted metadata. Portable mocked checks can exercise EPERM and reaping paths before any future Mac execution.
nextNoninvasiveHypotheses.currentLimit: These are investigation designs only. No code change, test execution, Mac probe, CI retry or new SDK acquisition is part of this review.

sources.supports: Per-flavor same-user policy and MAC hook; static hypothesis support rather than proof of the actual denied process.
Group member eligibility, zombie/system filtering and EPERM return; does not prove actual cleanup syscall ordering.
